title: Move-out, 2BHK flat, Bengaluru (BBMP area)

deductions.label: Repainting the whole flat
deductions.reason: The move-in checklist shows fresh paint and the handover photos show only light scuffs after 11 months: reasonable wear and tear, which the tenant does not have to restore.

deductions.label: Deep cleaning
deductions.reason: Clause 9 allows cleaning at actual cost up to Rs 5,000 and an invoice was shared. Within the agreed limit.

deductions.label: General wear and tear
deductions.reason: A lump sum for 'wear and tear' charges for exactly what the tenant is not liable for, with no itemised loss. Only reasonable compensation for actual loss is recoverable.

next_steps.title: Written demand
next_steps.detail: Send the approved challenge. Dhara schedules a follow-up 7 days later.

next_steps.title: Legal notice
next_steps.detail: If there is no refund, a firmer notice drafted from the same findings, preferably sent through an advocate.

next_steps.title: Civil money-recovery suit
next_steps.detail: The Rent Act does not apply here, so not the Rent Controller: a recovery suit in the Court of Small Causes, Bengaluru, within its pecuniary limit (limit unverified).

next_steps.title: Consumer forum (e-Daakhil)
next_steps.detail: Whether a tenancy deposit dispute is a consumer complaint is contested. Shown for completeness only.
